exam: APPSC Forest Range Officers Mains General Studies & Mental A
q:
Match the followings Table A to Table B
Table A:
I. AMRUT
II. HRIDAY
III. ABY
IV. UDAY
Table B:
1. Emphasis on the recharge of groundwater resources and improve the exploitation of the groundwater resources, with the involvement of people at the local level
2. Emphasize on the accessibility, security, safety, livelihood, cleanliness and faster service delivery in the heritage cities.
3. proposing an annual tariff increase, adjusting the quarterly fuel cost, reduction of interest burden, rationalization of coal price, reduction in the fuel cost through coal swapping, time bound loss reduction, etc.
4. to provide basic civic amenities to the urban areas to improve the quality of life
explanation: AMRUT – basic civic amenities (4); HRIDAY – heritage cities (2); Atal Bhujal Yojana – community groundwater management (1); UDAY – discom finances (3).
